The register repair for F-DG7-1022 is done, but `release-notes --check` now exits 1. The shipped `docs/handover/release-notes.md` is generated from the register and has to be regenerated. My write scope doesn't include `docs/handover/**`, so whoever owns it needs to run:

```
node tools/release/release-notes.mjs --csv docs/delivery/requirements.csv --out docs/handover/release-notes.md --write
```

The expected change is the four rewritten clause lines plus the register SHA lines, captured in `02-release-notes-diff.txt`. Once it is regenerated, the release notes' later clauses no longer cite any F-DG7-9xx id. I haven't closed F-DG7-1022; only a reviewer who isn't the author can.

**What changed in `docs/delivery/requirements.csv`:** only the notes column of the 25 rows that cite F-DG7-9xx ids. No status, acceptance or evidence text changed.
- **Old-branch ids qualified:** every one of the 53 citations is now marked as an old-branch record (branch `claude/mobily-transformation-platform-dg6-regate` at `1612f85fc`, D-281/D-282). Bare lists like "913, 914, 953-956" became full ids. I checked with `git show` that all 15 ids are CLOSED_VERIFIED on the old branch.
- **A dated note in each row:** it says the ids are historical citations and not conditions of this gate. Where a row cites old reviewer evidence under `test-evidence/DG7/qa/round-N/`, the note says those paths refer to `1612f85fc`. Directories with the same names on this branch hold the re-gate's own, different records.
- **Four later clauses rewritten** to name things the gate on this branch can show:
  - **REQ-DLV-012:** names the seven handbacks behind the C3 hits; `protocol-audit` reports exactly those seven here.
  - **REQ-DLV-014:** now refers to this branch's own findings (F-DG7-1001 onward).
  - **REQ-DLV-011:** adds the ARCH-R6 assignment-hash hit that D-282 discloses as F-DG7-1001.
  - **REQ-DLV-018:** C7 now counts this branch's findings.
- **The other 21 rows:** 14 have later clauses that cite no old id and needed no change; 7 have no later clause.
- **The full list of 25 rows** is in the handback, with old and new text in `07-changed-rows.txt`. No later clause in the register cites an F-DG7-9xx id any more.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6` | passed |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | passed |
| repository-wide prettier | passed |
| release-notes and handover tests | 65/65 passed |
| release-notes `--check` | fails, expected, until the regeneration above |
| `pnpm test` as written | blocked: vitest couldn't write `node_modules/.vite-temp` (read-only in my sandbox), so nothing ran |
| same three projects with `--configLoader runner` | 2 unit-node failures (below); unit-web 2199/2199; formula 259 passed, 2 skipped |
| full release-tool suite | 475 passed, 2 failed, 2 skipped (below) |
| disposable-PostgreSQL integration tests | not run: I touched no integration test and no product code |

None of the failures comes from the register change, but none of them is a pass either:
- **A20 contrast test:** couldn't write to `test-results/` (read-only here).
- **A13 READY test:** timed out under load. It passed 6/6 when rerun alone.
- **T-A5 build from archive:** the pnpm store under the read-only home directory couldn't be written.
- **T-M2:** `git status` changed during its 30-minute run because my files and the concurrent DO-D12 and SA-ADR72 runs were writing at the same time.

**Decisions for you:**
- **REQ-DLV-014 now also counts a finding accepted as an observation.** The rewritten clause accepts a Low, non-mandatory finding accepted under the protocol (by a specialist and the release-auditor), as well as one fixed and verified. That matches what the validator accepts at a gate, and the acceptance text is unchanged. A reviewer should confirm that reading; if it's rejected, the parenthesis comes out of the clause.
- **The assignment names the wrong branch.** It gives the working branch as `…dg6-regate`, which is the old branch. I worked on the checked-out `…dg7-regate`.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/`: the handback is `T-DG7-AN-P7J-transformation-analyst.md` and the logs are in `T-DG7-AN-P7J-evidence/`.
